main_text.l: um vita non excedere, quem vento-
edit, quod Plinius libr. xi. cap. 37.
narrat, Pecora in Euboea Chalcide fel
non habere, & uti fubdit, carent eo,
quae funt iftius generis innumera; nisi
& cervos omni prorfus bile carere, se-
d veficula duntaxat fellea deftitui, ut
vel hinc conftat, quia Plinius equo-
rum fel virulentum effe docet libr.

l.i: affectus fel est, vis ejus, excalfacere,
potentia, etiam in aere, pellibusque colore

page.notes: Printed text is partly damaged at the left edge and the first letters of several lines are cut off; readings such as "um", "ter" and "ur" are fragments of words cut by the scan edge. The line "tur" at the lower right is a catchword-like continuation of "damnatur" and is treated as its end. Some words in the original are uncertain due to blur (e.g. "minorum", "subtilius" repeated in the source).
